title: Fake carbonara di zucca
creator: giallozafferano
steps: Halve the squash and cook it in the air fryer at 180 °C for 25–30 minutes, or in the oven at 190 °C for about 45 minutes.
Scoop out the flesh and blend with a pinch of salt and some water into a smooth cream.
Cut the guanciale into strips and fry until crisp, then set aside, leaving the fat in the pan.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water, drain al dente and add to the pan with the squash cream and pecorino. Toss until coated.
Serve topped with the crispy guanciale and pepper.
